title: Bolas, Leshrac, and the Madaran Rift
summary: The contest between two ancient planeswalkers becomes the means of sealing Madara's fracture.
narrative: Leshrac attempted to use Jeska and the rifts to increase his own power before confronting Nicol Bolas.
Bolas defeated Leshrac and used the defeated walker's power to seal the Madaran rift, an outcome driven by rivalry rather than altruism.
